name: Gabi
description: Super Mario Bros makeover! Mario as the player, Goombas and Koopa Troopas as enemies, fireballs, question blocks, pipes, and blue sky!

name: Gabi
description: All Goombas now! Pipes and question blocks are solid - you can hide behind them and fireballs bounce off!

name: Papi
description: Warp pipes! Walk onto a pipe to teleport to the other one - Mario shrinks down and pops out the other side!

name: Soup
description: Tougher Goombas with health bars (2 hits to kill), slower fire rate, fewer spawns, and 10% chance to drop healing hearts!
